description: Visual artifact taxonomy for MacRunner visual regression lab.

artifacts.name: CLIENT_BOTTOM_BLACK_BAND
artifacts.description: Contiguous black band at bottom edge of client area, taller than normal borders.
artifacts.required_evidence: CG capture showing bottom band > 16 px contiguous black pixels
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Compare client rect / editor rect / statusbar rect against CG band. Trace WM_ERASEBKGND, DrawThemeBackground for statusbar part/state.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not shrink window size blindly; verify band is not normal macOS shadow or Wine desktop border.

artifacts.name: CLIENT_RIGHT_BLACK_BAND
artifacts.description: Contiguous black band at right edge of client area.
root_candidates: editor not filling full client width
artifacts.required_evidence: CG capture showing right band > 12 px contiguous black pixels
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Compare editor width against client width minus scrollbar width. Trace scrollbar DrawThemeBackground calls.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not assume the band is a scrollbar issue if the app does not use a right scrollbar.

artifacts.name: SCROLLBAR_BLACK_ARTIFACT
artifacts.description: Scrollbar thumb or track renders as solid black instead of native gradient/texture.
artifacts.required_evidence: CG zoom shows scrollbar area with zero colorful pixels and high black ratio
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Trace uxtheme scrollbar part DrawThemeBackground destination HDC. Check pPatBlt with ROP=0 in gdi32/bitblt.c.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not patch uxtheme blindly; verify part/state ID is correct and destination DIB is writable.

artifacts.name: FILE_DIALOG_FOLDER_ICONS_BLACK
artifacts.description: Open/Save dialog folder icons render as black silhouettes instead of colored/yellow folder icons.
artifacts.required_evidence: CG capture shows dialog with black icons; GetIconInfo trace shows hbmColor black or mask inverted
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Trace HICON → GetIconInfo → DrawIconEx → ImageList _Draw → ListView/TreeView custom draw. Check mask inversion and alpha premultiplication.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not patch shell32 icon loading; the icon resource itself may be correct and the loss happens at draw time.

artifacts.name: TOOLBAR_BLACK_OR_LOW_COLOR
artifacts.description: Toolbar buttons show gray/black placeholder squares or very low colorful pixel count.
artifacts.required_evidence: CG colorful_pixels below colorful_floor threshold; OR CG shows colored icons but helper shows black
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: If CG < floor → fix comctl32 fill / ImageList / GetIconInfo path. If CG >= floor but helper shows black → fix helper readback, not runtime.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do NOT instrument comctl32/toolbar.c directly (causes c000007b regressions).

artifacts.name: STATUSBAR_BAD_BACKGROUND
artifacts.description: Statusbar background is black or wrong color instead of matching window chrome.
artifacts.required_evidence: Bottom ~20 px band shows solid black or non-matching color compared to menu/toolbar chrome
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Trace WM_ERASEBKGND → DefWindowProc → FillRect / DrawThemeBackground for statusbar part. Compare against Windows baseline.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not change statusbar height blindly; verify color mismatch is not a theme difference between macOS and Windows.

artifacts.name: STATUSBAR_BAD_TEXT_BASELINE
artifacts.description: Statusbar text is misaligned, clipped, or invisible because baseline/height metrics are wrong.
artifacts.required_evidence: Text characters partially visible or entirely missing in statusbar region while background renders
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Compare GetTextMetricsW output against Windows baseline. Trace ExtTextOutW x,y coordinates for statusbar text.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not assume font substitution is the problem; check the text baseline first.

artifacts.name: MENU_TOO_TALL
artifacts.description: Menu bar or top-level chrome is taller than native Windows baseline.
artifacts.required_evidence: Top bar height from CG capture exceeds known Windows baseline by > 20%
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Measure non-client metrics (GetSystemMetrics for SM_CYMENU, SM_CYCAPTION). Compare against Windows baseline.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not reduce menu height without a baseline; some apps intentionally use taller menus.

artifacts.name: TOOLBAR_TOO_TALL
artifacts.description: Toolbar band is excessively tall, consuming editor real estate.
artifacts.required_evidence: Toolbar band height from CG exceeds baseline by > 20% or shows large empty vertical padding
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Trace TB_SETBUTTONSIZE, TB_SETBITMAPSIZE, TB_AUTOSIZE messages. Compare against Windows baseline.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not override toolbar size from helper; trace the actual message path.

artifacts.name: EDITOR_NOT_FILLING_CLIENT
artifacts.description: Editor surface does not extend to the full available client area.
root_candidates: app intentionally reserves space for docking panels
artifacts.required_evidence: Editor HWND rect is smaller than client rect minus known chrome
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Compare GetClientRect(main) with GetWindowRect(scintilla). Check if the gap is intentional (docking, sidebars) or a layout bug.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not resize the editor from outside the app; trace the app's own layout messages.

artifacts.name: HELPER_CAPTURE_FALSE_NEGATIVE
artifacts.description: Helper-side bitmap readback reports failure while CG capture shows correct visual.
artifacts.required_evidence: CG colorful_pixels >= floor but helper reports FAIL or low colorful count
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Replace or fix helper bitmap readback. Use CG as ground truth. Do NOT patch runtime.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not change Wine or engine based on helper-only evidence.

artifacts.name: CG_CAPTURE_UNAVAILABLE
artifacts.description: CoreGraphics screenshot failed or returned no image.
artifacts.required_evidence: screencapture returns error or output file missing / zero bytes
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Check sandbox permissions, window visibility, and timing. Add retry with longer readiness delay.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not classify as product failure when CG capture is missing.

artifacts.name: WINEMAC_PRESENT_DIRTY_RECT_BUG
artifacts.description: winemac driver leaves unpainted black areas because dirty rect updates are incomplete.
root_candidates: macOS display driver winemac.drv dirty rect handling
artifacts.required_evidence: Black bands appear or disappear after window resize/minimize/restore. Not reproducible on Windows.
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Trace WM_PAINT → BeginPaint → GetUpdateRect in winemac.drv. Compare dirty rect against actual invalid region.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not force full-window repaint from app code; fix the driver.

artifacts.name: UTHEME_BLACK_BACKGROUND
artifacts.description: Theme-drawn backgrounds render black instead of themed gradient/color.
artifacts.required_evidence: Dialog or panel background is solid black where Windows shows textured/colored background
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Trace DrawThemeBackground for the specific part/state. Check pPutImage / StretchDIBits color table and mask.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not replace themed drawing with solid fills; fix the theme rendering path.

artifacts.name: GETICONINFO_COLOR_LOSS
artifacts.description: GetIconInfo returns a black hbmColor bitmap for a valid color icon.
artifacts.required_evidence: Trace shows GetIconInfo called with valid HICON but hbmColor is solid black or mask-only
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Trace CreateIconIndirect, CopyImage, GetIconInfo in user32. Check if the icon was created from a 32bpp DIB with alpha.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not assume the icon file is corrupted; the loss happens at API level.

artifacts.name: IMAGELIST_MASK_ALPHA_BUG
artifacts.description: ImageList_Draw or ImageList_GetIcon loses color because mask is applied incorrectly or alpha is treated as mask.
artifacts.required_evidence: ImageList operations on 32bpp icons produce black where color should be visible
artifacts.safe_codex_next_action: Trace ImageList_Draw → _Draw → BitBlt with SRCAND then SRCPAINT. Check if alpha channel is treated as mask.
artifacts.what_not_to_fix: Do not replace ImageList with custom drawing; fix the mask/alpha interpretation.
